name: Featured SuperApps
description: Highlighted SuperApps showcasing the best of interoperable digital finance.

name: Collateral
description: Applications for repo, margining, collateral mobility, and liquidity optimization across markets and ledgers.

name: Issuer Tools
description: Tools for issuing, publishing and distributing tokenized assets to investors or partner platforms.

name: Trading
description: Execution venues, order management systems, and investor-facing investment and trading tools for buying, selling, and managing assets.

name: Market Infrastructure
description: Core market systems including CSDs, transfer agents, and asset servicing platforms.

name: Payments
description: Solutions for cash movement, payment rails, and settlement flows such as DvP, PvP, and real-time transfers.

name: Custody & Identity
description: Safekeeping of assets and provision of digital custody, identity, and transaction authorization services.

name: Lending
description: Apps that enable lending in the digital asset space

name: System Apps
description: The core applications of the router, providing access to router APIs, services for developers, router admin functionality, and provide infrastructure services for other SuperApps

name: Connectivity
description: Cross-chain, cross-ledger, and legacy protocol integration tools enabling interoperability across financial systems.

name: Dev Tools
description: APIs, SDKs, and integration layers that enable developers to build, extend, or connect financial applications.
